recommendation: Keep the audit commit and do not restore condition-partOf in core. Any future cleanup of the Extension Pack condition-related comment that still mentions a condition-partOf-style name should be handled separately in the Extension Pack, not as a core FHIR-12668 fix.
issue_request: FHIR-12668 was a Published/Persuasive Patient Care change request for DSTU2 asking that extension-condition-partof support referencing Condition in addition to Observation or Procedure.
initial_application: Git commit 913017fdf7d3b9fad5bb3c88c1cfa7395923b097 explicitly applied the request by changing source/condition/condition-extensions-spreadsheet.xml from Reference(Observation|Procedure) to Reference(Observation|Procedure|Condition) and updating the extension wording.
additional_context: FHIR-13783 later clarified the condition-partOf wording, kept Condition as an allowed target, and added condition-related for unspecified condition-to-condition relationships. FHIR-14446 later switched Patient Care workflow resource-specific extensions to common workflow extensions; commit f235b25c5ef0e84d57ea366f811fa801f1db9a25 removed the Condition-specific partOf row. The current Extension Pack event-partOf definition has Condition as a context and Reference(Resource) as its target, which includes Condition.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No current core source file should be edited for the obsolete condition-partOf extension name.
